files.title: File:Lonet Theater, Herrick Avenue, Wellington, OH - 54432411164.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built circa 1920, this Renaissance Revival-style building was constructed to serve as a movie theater for the village of Wellington.  The building is clad in red brick with a green terra cotta tile shed awning over the front entrance with heavy timber brackets, a large central arched bay with stone trim and wood-clad infill, two smaller window bays with decorative trim surrounds, and a lower wing to the side that contains a small retail space.
